com.sun.org.apache.xml.internal.serializer

类 AttributesImplSerializer

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.xml.sax.helpers.AttributesImpl
      • com.sun.org.apache.xml.internal.serializer.AttributesImplSerializer
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    Attributes

    public final class AttributesImplSerializer
extends AttributesImpl
    This class extends org.xml.sax.helpers.AttributesImpl which implements org. xml.sax.Attributes. But for optimization this class adds a Map for faster lookup of an index by qName, which is commonly done in the stream serializer.
    另请参阅:
    Attributes
